name: r6pack
note: Round trip 6 probe: the atlas. Every trip so far used the default one-part-per-page atlas; this rig is built with --pack, so several regions share one page and each carries an xy offset into it. The skeleton is deliberately ordinary -- four regions and one rotate -- so that anything that moves is the atlas and not the rig. Fixed-point control: the whole skeleton, which is the same shape pass 1 carried six times.
